verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs say you can send stablecoins from a BVNK account and automatically on-ramp and send to blockchain addresses. A documented API call (POST /payment/v1/rules) links a fiat virtual account to a crypto address, and webhooks fire on payout events. However, the evidence shows no dedicated crypto-payout endpoint, no stored-recipient model, and no documented payout status lifecycle through to on-chain settlement. Missing for 10: an explicit stablecoin payout API endpoint and reference, payouts to saved or stored recipients, a documented payout status model through to final settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
